name: kirana
description: Hover the CSS a style compiles to, see token colours, an inline summary of what each element receives, completion for conditions and utilities, and the compiler's diagnostics as you type.
author: The Kirana authors

commands.title: Explain Precedence of the Property Under the Cursor

kirana.server.path.markdownDescription: The `kirana-style` binary to run. Empty: the project's own `node_modules/.bin/kirana-style` (or `kirana` from 0.1.0), so the editor runs the engine the build does. A `.js` or `.ts` path runs with `node`.

kirana.inlayHints.enabled.markdownDescription: Show what each element receives after `sx={…}` (`grid · gap 1rem · p 1.5rem`).

kirana.inlayHints.maxLength.markdownDescription: The longest summary after an element, in characters; the rest is counted as `+N`. `0` shows every declaration. VS Code also cuts hints at `editor.inlayHints.maximumLength` (43 by default): set that to `0`.

kirana.inlayHints.colors.markdownDescription: Colour the summary after each element by group, as the card does (layout blue, box green, colour orange…). Off: VS Code's own one-colour inlay hints.

kirana.inlayHints.icon.markdownDescription: Show Kirana's icon before each summary.

kirana.inlayHints.opacity.markdownDescription: How strongly the summary reads against the code, from `0.1` to `1`.

kirana.codeLens.enabled.markdownDescription: Show declaration, condition and bridged-value counts above `css()` and `recipe()`.

kirana.trace.server.description: Log the messages between the editor and the language server.

kirana.hover.diagrams.markdownDescription: Draw the box model, layout, colours and type of a style as a picture in the hover; off: a text drawing.

kirana.rootFontSize.markdownDescription: Pixels per `rem`, for the pixel equivalents in hovers and tooltips.

kirana.inspector.followCursor.markdownDescription: The Style Inspector shows what the cursor is on.

kirana.fold.enabled.markdownDescription: Show long one-line `css({…})` objects as their summary until the cursor is on their line.

enumDescriptions: Replace a long one-line style object with its summary until the cursor is on its line.
Keep the object and lower its opacity until the cursor is on its line.
kirana.fold.mode.markdownDescription: What Style Fold does to a long one-line `css({…})` object off the cursor's line.

kirana.fold.opacity.markdownDescription: The opacity of a dimmed object (`kirana.fold.mode`: `dim`).

kirana.fold.minLength.markdownDescription: Objects shorter than this many characters stay as written.

kirana.fold.icon.markdownDescription: Show Kirana's icon before a folded summary.

scripts.package: cp ../brand/icon.png icon.png && cp ../../../../CHANGELOG.md ../../../../LICENSE . && bun run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --out kirana.vsix
